newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil slips with IPE futures, premiums hold.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil slips with IPE futures, premiums hold.

text.p: NWE gas oil fell as futures dropped. Physical activity was very slow and premiums were largely unchanged.
March IPE gas oil closed $2.50 down at $174.75 a tonne.
Traders said mild weather throughout much of Europe combined with industry functions in London this week had almost brought the market to a standstill.
"There is hardly anybody in, and no one's in a hurry to do anything," commented one trader.
Barge premiums held around March IPE +$1-2 for second half Feb material, with March barrels attracting scant attention.
FOD cargoes were pegged steady around March IPE +$2-4, but traders said the market was so thin that it was difficult to assess a true value.
They said activity should pick up by Thursday as more market players return to their desks.
Russian premiums did come under pressure, falling $1-2 after deals yesterday, settling around March IPE +50 cents to $1.50.
